newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks firm in London, awaiting "Tankin".
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks firm in London, awaiting "Tankin".

text.p: Most Japanese shares were firmer in London, but trading volume was exceptionally light ahead of the release of the Bank of Japan's key business survey, traders said.
The Nikkei 50 average was 18.99 points higher in London at 1,427.32.
In Tokyo, the benchmark Nikkei 225 average rose 26.53 to 21,022.41.
"There was very little business today," said one trader.
Traders said investors were reluctant to get into the market until they had seen the BOJ's so-called "Tankin" report.
